purpose: Public-safe editorial discovery overlay: maps relevant KDI/PSC ideas to optional E4BL series; no field verification, institutional evidence or public post approval implied.

editorial_series.name: Inside Our Classroom
editorial_series.description: Actual, dated and evidenced teacher-led classroom moments, lessons and learner participation without staging or learning-outcome claims.
editorial_series.evidence_rule: Confirmed class activity/time/location; teacher signoff; original media provenance; informed permission and child safeguarding before publication.
editorial_series.publication_rule: No identifying learner data, no unapproved faces/voices, no inference of improved proficiency from participation.

editorial_series.name: Learn with E4BL
editorial_series.description: Age-appropriate English, Bangla, literacy, numeracy and home-learning tips developed from sound educational practice and checked references.
editorial_series.evidence_rule: Teaching/curriculum objective and independently reviewed source or teacher-approved example; accurate age/grade scope, child-friendly presentation.
editorial_series.publication_rule: Distinguish practical activity from research claim; education/technical review and final copy approval required.

example_post.title: Woof Woof! Meow Meow! Who's in the Classroom?
example_post.reporter: User described this as published on the preceding day
